name: 2026 APPAM Fall Research Conference
organizer: Association for Public Policy Analysis & Management (APPAM)
conf_dates_note: Theme: Fifty States, Fifty Systems: State Policy Variations and Impacts
deadline_note: Submissions opened February 2026. A separate Late-Breaking Roundtable call (late August to late September) is also closed.
submission_requirements: Panels: 3-4 papers, a chair and 1-2 discussants. Roundtables: abstract max. 500 words, 2-4 speakers plus a non-speaking moderator. No more than two people per affiliation per submission; a paper can only be submitted once. APPAM MemberClicks account required.
membership_required: No (APPAM membership optional to submit or attend)
